description: This file defines the 'GenericValue' class in the 'org.apache.ofbiz.entity' package, which handles persistence and relationships for entity instances within the OFBiz framework. It includes factory methods for creating instances, methods for database operations (create, store, remove, refresh), and methods for retrieving related entities. The class also contains nested classes and utility methods used for entity management.

classes.name: GenericValue
classes.description: Represents a generic entity value object capable of handling persistence operations and entity relationships in the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: GenericValue.NullGenericValue
classes.description: A specialized subclass representing a null or placeholder entity value.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory methods for creating new GenericValue instances in various ways, such as from a ModelEntity, Map of fields, or from existing objects.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores the current GenericValue instance in the persistent store via the delegator.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the current GenericValue instance from the persistent store.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the current GenericValue from the database.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Refreshes the GenericValue from the cache.

methods.name: getRelated
methods.description: Retrieves related entities based on a relation name, with various overloads for order and cache usage.

methods.name: getRelatedMulti
methods.description: Retrieves related entities for multi-to-multi relationships.

methods.name: getRelatedOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single related entity for the current value.

methods.name: removeRelated
methods.description: Removes related entities based on relation name.

methods.name: getRelatedDummyPK
methods.description: Returns a dummy primary key for related entities.
